<?php

class Item
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $name,
        public int $qty,
        public float $price,
    ) {
    }

    public function value(): float
    {
        return $this->qty * $this->price;
    }
}

class Inventory
{
    private array $items = [];

    public function add(string $name, int $qty, float $price): void
    {
        $this->items[$name] = new Item($name, $qty, $price);
    }

    public function restock(string $name, int $amount): void
    {
        $this->items[$name]->qty += $amount;
    }

    public function sell(string $name, int $amount): bool
    {
        $item = $this->items[$name];
        if ($item->qty < $amount) {
            return false;
        }
        $item->qty -= $amount;
        return true;
    }

    public function lowStock(int $threshold): array
    {
        $names = [];
        foreach ($this->items as $item) {
            if ($item->qty <= $threshold) {
                $names[] = $item->name;
            }
        }
        sort($names);
        return $names;
    }

    public function totalValue(): float
    {
        return array_sum(array_map(fn (Item $item) => $item->value(), $this->items));
    }

    public function report(): array
    {
        $rows = array_values($this->items);
        usort($rows, fn (Item $a, Item $b) => [$b->value(), $a->name] <=> [$a->value(), $b->name]);
        return array_map(fn (Item $item) => sprintf('%-12s%5d%10.2f', $item->name, $item->qty, $item->value()), $rows);
    }
}

$inventory = new Inventory();
$inventory->add('apple', 3, 0.5);
$inventory->add('banana', 12, 0.25);
$inventory->add('cherry', 0, 4.0);
$inventory->add('date', 7, 1.5);
$inventory->add('elderberry', 2, 6.0);
$inventory->restock('cherry', 5);
echo 'Sold banana: ' . ($inventory->sell('banana', 4) ? 'yes' : 'no') . "\n";
echo 'Sold apple: ' . ($inventory->sell('apple', 10) ? 'yes' : 'no') . "\n";
echo 'Low stock: ' . implode(', ', $inventory->lowStock(3)) . "\n";
foreach ($inventory->report() as $line) {
    echo $line . "\n";
}
printf("Total: %.2f\n", $inventory->totalValue());

<?php

const EDGES = [
    ['A', 'B', 4], ['A', 'C', 2], ['B', 'C', 1], ['B', 'D', 5], ['C', 'D', 8],
    ['C', 'E', 10], ['D', 'E', 2], ['D', 'F', 6], ['E', 'F', 3],
];

function buildGraph(array $edges): array
{
    $graph = [];
    foreach ($edges as [$a, $b, $weight]) {
        $graph[$a][] = [$b, $weight];
        $graph[$b][] = [$a, $weight];
    }
    return $graph;
}

function dijkstra(array $graph, string $start): array
{
    $dist = array_fill_keys(array_keys($graph), PHP_INT_MAX);
    $prev = [];
    $dist[$start] = 0;
    $queue = new SplPriorityQueue();
    $queue->setExtractFlags(SplPriorityQueue::EXTR_BOTH);
    $queue->insert($start, 0);
    while (!$queue->isEmpty()) {
        ['data' => $node, 'priority' => $priority] = $queue->extract();
        $d = -$priority;
        if ($d > $dist[$node]) {
            continue;
        }
        foreach ($graph[$node] as [$neighbor, $weight]) {
            $nd = $d + $weight;
            if ($nd < $dist[$neighbor]) {
                $dist[$neighbor] = $nd;
                $prev[$neighbor] = $node;
                $queue->insert($neighbor, -$nd);
            }
        }
    }
    return [$dist, $prev];
}

function pathTo(array $prev, string $start, string $target): array
{
    $path = [$target];
    while (end($path) !== $start) {
        $path[] = $prev[end($path)];
    }
    return array_reverse($path);
}

$graph = buildGraph(EDGES);
[$dist, $prev] = dijkstra($graph, 'A');
ksort($dist);
foreach ($dist as $node => $d) {
    echo "$node: $d\n";
}
echo 'Path: ' . implode(' -> ', pathTo($prev, 'A', 'F')) . "\n";

EDGES = [
  ['A', 'B', 4], ['A', 'C', 2], ['B', 'C', 1], ['B', 'D', 5], ['C', 'D', 8],
  ['C', 'E', 10], ['D', 'E', 2], ['D', 'F', 6], ['E', 'F', 3]
].freeze

def build_graph(edges)
  graph = Hash.new { |hash, key| hash[key] = [] }
  edges.each do |a, b, weight|
    graph[a] << [b, weight]
    graph[b] << [a, weight]
  end
  graph
end

def dijkstra(graph, start)
  dist = graph.keys.to_h { |node| [node, Float::INFINITY] }
  prev = {}
  dist[start] = 0
  queue = [[0, start]]
  until queue.empty?
    d, node = queue.min_by(&:first)
    queue.delete([d, node])
    next if d > dist[node]

    graph[node].each do |neighbor, weight|
      nd = d + weight
      next unless nd < dist[neighbor]

      dist[neighbor] = nd
      prev[neighbor] = node
      queue << [nd, neighbor]
    end
  end
  [dist, prev]
end

def path_to(prev, start, target)
  path = [target]
  path << prev[path.last] until path.last == start
  path.reverse
end

graph = build_graph(EDGES)
dist, prev = dijkstra(graph, 'A')
dist.keys.sort.each { |node| puts "#{node}: #{dist[node]}" }
puts "Path: #{path_to(prev, 'A', 'F').join(' -> ')}"
